findings.summary: The cause of the 4nff record is not determined, and under cause (c) the fix only adds a flag.
findings.evidence: The request asks to 'find out why' introspection 4nff recorded new_class=true. The plan lists four possible conditions but can prove none of them, because records/ is absent from both the planner's copy and the producer's snapshot (system facts: Producer snapshot). If condition (c) or (d) is the real one, the 4nff-like event would still record empty earlier_cases in production. Fix: Have the CHANGELOG and the doc comments state that the code-level cause is the same in every case: narrow_cases never reads the outcome reason (introspect.rs:841-850), and apply_answer then drops whatever was not passed in. Say plainly that which of (a)-(d) applied to 4nff is unverified. Say that under (c) the change adds a flag rather than earlier cases.

findings.summary: A job with several outcome files keeps whichever reason was read last.
findings.evidence: read_records reads every outcome*.json file in a job directory (introspect.rs:327-339), and a blocked job can have a later outcome (jobs.rs:68, after_blocked). With one reason per job, whichever file is read last wins. That can be a later landed outcome, which would hide an earlier admission refusal. Fix: Fill job_reasons only from the primary outcome (not after_blocked), to match known.jobs[job].outcome in the git overlay. Or keep every reason for a job and match on any of them.

findings.summary: Two files outside the reading's deliverables are needed and justified.
findings.evidence: producer_loop is in producer.rs:120 and send_back_text is in send_back.rs:88, so the in-loop check can only go there. The reading's deliverables list run/mod.rs instead. Fix: Keep both files. In the change description, say they replace the reading's guess of run/mod.rs as where the producer loop lives.

findings.summary: The criterion 2 test passes on base by design.
findings.evidence: The plan states that this test is a guard and passes on base. Criterion 2 does not require it to fail on base, so this is acceptable. Fix: No change needed. You could also assert that working_diff_scan returns no findings for the allow-listed diff, so the test exercises the new code directly as well as through the absence of a refusal.

summary: I checked the plan's claims against the snapshot and they hold. producer_loop (producer.rs:120-300) has the unmet/unchanged self-check, the PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS = 1 exhaustion branch and the send_back_text call. Snapshot::change_list and work_tree_tree exist (snapshot.rs:200-218). Git::added_lines returns no line numbers (athena-git lib.rs:555). admit() writes '{path} adds an email address outside the allow-list' once per path (admission.rs:394-403). The candidate failure text is 'admission refused the change: ' plus the details joined by '; ' (candidate.rs:150-159). narrow_cases filters only on class_of_work and category, capped at 5 (introspect.rs:841-850). OutcomeRow has no reason field (introspect.rs:220). introspect() reads past cases from disk with read_records and reads `known` from git (introspect.rs:1322-1327). FakeTurn.edits, base_script and athena_with all exist. The approach is sound. The in-loop scan diffs the snapshot base against the work-tree tree, which is the same change set the candidate is built from (candidate.rs:64-94), so it reuses admission's rule and allow-list rather than a heuristic. The refusal key is a fixed admission rule phrase, and it is used only for reasons with the admission prefix, so common words do not cause false matches. The demonstrations run through Athena::go with the real config, and the criterion 1 and 3 tests would fail on base. The plan is honest that the criterion 3 test fails on base by not compiling. Athena's two scope findings (producer.rs and send_back.rs are not listed deliverables) are justified: producer_loop and send_back_text live in those files, so the reading's deliverable list missed them. Only minor issues remain: the specific cause behind the 4nff record is not proven, and a job with several outcome records keeps one reason.
